requirements: R1: Migrate task queues and rate-limiting from relational/in-memory to Redis

slices.title: Migrate message dispatch queue and rate-limiting to Redis
slices.jtbd: When implementing Redis dispatch for this epic, I want to replace relational task queues and rate-limiting with Redis, so that message dispatch is efficiently distributed with minimal DB overhead.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given multiple running campaigns, When outbound message actions are dispatched, Then the system pushes them onto a Redis-backed queue.
Given rate limits are configured, When dispatching messages, Then a Redis-backed rate-limiter enforces the limits.
Given Redis is unavailable, When dispatch is attempted, Then the system gracefully falls back or pauses dispatch.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Database lock contention during high-volume dispatch
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce message dispatch latency and DB lock contention from current baseline to 40% lower

requirements: R1: Implement persisted configuration for AI system prompt templates including FAQ, personas, goals, and tone

slices.title: Persist and supply custom AI system prompts
slices.jtbd: When implementing prompt customization for this epic, I want to persist prompt templates and supply them to the generation engine, so that AI dialogues align with campaign objectives.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a newly created campaign, When the administrator updates the system prompt settings, Then the custom prompt is saved.
Given an active dialogue, When the AI evaluates the message, Then the saved custom prompt is supplied to the AI generation engine.
Given invalid prompt data, When saving is attempted, Then the system rejects the update and logs an error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase custom prompt parameter utilization from 0% to 100% of campaigns

epics.title: Unblock Project Orchestration Backlog
epics.jtbd: When managing project delivery, I want to merge the stalled deliverable, so that the orchestration flow can process the next wishlist compile candidates.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce orchestration stall time from current baseline to 0 hours
epics.tocConstraintRef: Stalled merge pipeline blocking wishlist orchestration
requirements: R1: Resolve the single unmerged deliverable holding back 5 wishlist compile candidates

slices.title: Merge stalled deliverable to unblock orchestration
slices.jtbd: When implementing merge hygiene for this epic, I want to review and merge the stalled deliverable, so that the orchestration pipeline is unblocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an orchestration pipeline stalled by an unmerged PR, When the deliverable is reviewed and merged to main, Then the PR is closed.
Given the PR is merged, When ProjectFlowService runs, Then it resumes processing the 5 new candidates.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Pending pull request blocking main project flow
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce pending blocking PRs from 1 to 0
